descriptors.concept_name: Extracts Of Financial Statements Of Listed Entity
descriptors.definition: This section outlines practical examples of financial statement extracts from listed entities regarding assets held for sale and related accounting policies. It highlights structural differences between reporting frameworks for non-current assets and discontinued operations.
inclusion: Financial statement extracts of listed companies
Accounting policy disclosures for held for sale assets
nearby_distinctions: Differs from standard-level theoretical provisions by illustrating practical application in corporate annual reports.

descriptors.concept_name: Significant Differences In Ind As 105 Vis-À-Vis As 24
descriptors.definition: This section compares normative treatments between Ind AS and previous standards regarding asset classification and disposal frameworks. It contrasts measurement bases, time limitations, and definitions of discontinued versus discontinuing operations.
terminology: fair value less costs to sell
inclusion: Comparative analysis of scope and objectives
Distinctions in measurement and time period criteria
nearby_distinctions: Contrasts Ind AS 105 which governs held for sale assets and discontinued operations with AS 24 which focuses solely on discontinuing operations.
